LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 7.3.1 PERSONAL AND POSSESSIVE PRONOUNS.

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade seven
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 7
Topic 7.3: Grammar in Use 7.3.1 Personal and possessive pronouns.
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Grammar in Use 7.3.1 Personal and possessive pronouns., part of Strand 7 in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade seven ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: How can you avoid unnecessary repetition in sentences? 2. Why should we avoid unnecessary repetition?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Grammar in Use 7.3.1 Personal and possessive pronouns. together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Communication and collaboration: A learner corrects use of pronouns in sentences and story writing

Values:
Respect: A learner uses pronouns to construct sentences to refer to others in the class.

Link to other subjects:

● Computer science: Digital skills are enhanced as learners refer to print and non-print materials to search for personal

pronouns.

● French, German, Chinese, and Arabic cover pronouns in grammar.

Suggested Learning Resources

● Manilla papers, felt pens, braille chart
